headline: MOGUL v11.3 — power & influence
summary: A new tier system on top of net worth. Beyond money, players accrue political and social capital — influence — that unlocks a power ladder from industry mogul ($10M) to influencer ($100M) to national power ($1B) to state leader ($10B). Influence comes from charity (1 per $10K), founding a club (5/year passive), board seats (3 per founded club + 1.5 per member club), and media ownership (10 per source: film studio + verified 1M+ followers). Diminishing returns: 1 / (1 + sqrt(I/100)). Three advocacy actions: lobby industry policy (+5% biz for 1 year, 25 influence, requires industry mogul), place a board nominee (permanent +10% biz, 60 influence, requires influencer), endow a foundation (permanent +20% influence gain, 120 influence, requires national power). Tier is sticky — once unlocked, it stays even if net worth drops.
